text:
Julia Park: Hey team — planning the weekend shadow rota. I (Julia) will be primary Sat morning but I have an appointment Sat evening (5–7pm PT). Who can take the Sat evening primary? Also we should do a quick shadow handoff run-through for @Sasha, she's new to on-call.

Sasha Liu: happy to shadow! can someone do a 30m run-through today? not sure about the escalation matrix yet.

Omar Khan: I can take Sat evening primary if needed. Quick Q: do we prefer primary/secondary handoff at the top of the hour or at shift boundaries? last time we had a gap when people switched late.

Ben Ortiz: we aim for handoffs at shift boundaries (12:00/00:00 UTC) to avoid partial overlap. but if there is a known overlap gap, call it out in #eng-oncall so we can schedule a short pairing window.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT TEST: This is an automated page test. Please confirm receipt by reacting with :eyes: within 10m. (test id: t-20260314-1)

Julia Park: got the test :eyes: — Sasha can you confirm you saw it too?

Sasha Liu: saw it, reacted. :white_check_mark:

Omar Khan: confirmed. also quick note: Ben, I'm on PTO Sun morning, so coverage gap on Sun 08:00–12:00 UTC unless we swap.

Ben Ortiz: I can flip my shift (take Sun morning) if Omar covers Sat evening. that works for me.

Julia Park: great. plan: Sat morning primary Julia (00:00–17:00 PT), Sat evening primary Omar (17:00–23:59 PT), Sun morning primary Ben (00:00–12:00 UTC). Sasha will shadow Sat evening with Omar. I'll add this to the handoff doc.

Omar Khan: Sasha — during shadow, focus on pager triage + runbook sections: 'pgdb-high-cpu', 'api-503s', and 'region-failover'. pointers below.

--- runbook snippets ---

Ben Ortiz: copying minimal steps for triage:
```
1) check oncall status: /oncall status
2) check recent deploys: /deploys recent --env=prod
3) query logs (last 15m): k9s pod -n prod | select inference-api && kubectl logs -f <pod> --since=15m
4) if 5xx spike, open P1 channel and notify infra team: @infra-lead
```

Sasha Liu: thanks — can we have a short checklist to follow during shadow handoff?

Julia Park: adding checklist to thread:
- verify you can ack test page from phone
- login to console (https://console.redwood.ai) and confirm access
- run `/oncall whoami` to confirm role
- open runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/oncall/runbooks#triage
- pair on 1st live page (primary leads, shadow follows prompts)

Sasha Liu: all clear, thanks. when's the pairing slot?

Ben Ortiz: propose Sat 17:30 PT quick pairing for 30m. Omar, you good?

Omar Khan: yes, 17:30 PT works.

oncall-bot: PAGERS: High 5xx rate detected in eu-west-1 (api-edge). This is an automated monitoring alert, not a page — threshold crossed. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/alerts/api-edge

Julia Park: FYI — if that becomes a page, follow runbook 'api-503s' first — quick mitigation is to revert recent traffic-weighted routes or scale inference pool.

Ben Ortiz: adding a short note about escalation timeline: 0–5m triage by primary, 5–15m notify infra and open incident if degradation persists, 15+m escalate to eng leads.

Sasha Liu: bookmarked runbooks and dashboard. I'll join the Sat 17:30 slot and shadow.

Julia Park: thanks everyone — I'll update the oncall-calendar and put a short note in #calendar. ping me if anything changes.

Omar Khan: tldr: Sat evening coverage confirmed (Omar primary, Sasha shadow), Sun morning covered by Ben. No uncovered gaps.

Ben Ortiz: ack. will update handoff doc and leave instructions in #eng-oncall pinned messages.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: Handoff checklist template added to https://docs.redwood.ai/oncall/handoffs (auto-generated)

Julia Park: closing thread — feel free to DM for swaps. :wave:
